name: Incline Straight-Leg Hip Raise
steps: Lie faceup on an inclined bench with your head at the high end and grasp the bench behind your head.
Extend your legs straight down the bench and press your lower back firmly against the pad.
Raise your straight legs toward the ceiling, then curl your pelvis off the bench.
Lower your hips and straight legs slowly back down with control just short of resting on the pad.
tips: Control the lowering phase slowly rather than letting your hips thud back onto the bench.
Avoid swinging your legs upward with momentum; initiate the hip lift by curling your pelvis.
